mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at 56 degrees with overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park. The moon is in its Waxing Crescent phase, and while the ISS is passing overhead tonight, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight will cool down to an overnight low of 51 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona has approved two additional polling locations. Residents should visit the My Vote Wisconsin website to confirm their current polling place before heading out to vote. All locations are fully accessible to elderly and disabled voters.

There is plenty happening in town. Today, enjoy the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory, or Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, you can look forward to Art House 360 events and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing.

Regarding the weekly police report, on October 7, officers responded to a collision on Basswood Avenue where a 17-year-old operating an electric motorcycle collided with a vehicle that was attempting a left turn.
Today's flavor at Culver's is the delightful Dark Chocolate Decadence. The store is currently open but will be closing in just 52 minutes, so make sure to get there soon to grab a scoop.
